Therefore 545+18 sum_{s<t}Re(b_s conjugate(b_t))=500+9|sum b_s|² with full normalization. Constant phases attain 725 and cubic chirp a_t=omega^(t³) makes b_s=omega^(2s), sum zero. Reduced 4x4 exponent matrix has independently computed integer determinant +5, hence surjective fivefold torus covering. Over fifth roots, cyclotomic minimal polynomial forces b exponents a permutation; a quadratic exponent cannot permute F5, so h(t)=At+Bt²+Ct³ with C≠0, count 5*5*4=100. Independently exhausted 5^4=625 normalized phase alphabets and direct DFT checked examples 500,545,725. Connected torus continuity fills interval; no claim arbitrary magnitudes.
